description: The package documentation's quoted parameter name is an error
notes: The README's parameter names are bare identifiers, while the package documentation's example writes params = ["name"], and the JSON syntax gives names as strings. hashicorp/hcl reads each name with hcl.ExprAsKeyword (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), which gives no name for a template in the native syntax, so a quoted name is an error.
